clue: In Pixar's 2025 film Elio, an 11-year-old boy is beamed up and mistaken for Earth's leader by this interplanetary organization.
reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Communiverse! Elio has been sending messages into space hoping for exactly this. [laughs] Careful what you wish for, kid.

clue: In Disney's 1975 film Escape to Witch Mountain, orphaned siblings with psychic powers are named Tony and this sister.
reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Tia! Tony and Tia Malone were played by Ike Eisenmann and Kim Richards. [chuckles] Sibling telepathy beats texting any day.

clue: In the 2018 Disney Channel movie Zombies, the undead live walled off in Zombietown on the edge of this cookie-cutter suburb.
reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Seabrook! Zed and Addison prove a zombie and a cheerleader can rule the school. [laughs] Brains AND pom-poms!

clue: In the 2022 Chip 'n Dale: Rescue Rangers movie, the bootlegging villain Sweet Pete is a grown-up version of this Disney character.
reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Peter Pan! Voiced by Will Arnett, Sweet Pete grew up after all. [laughs] Never Land would be so disappointed.

clue: In Disney's 2003 film The Haunted Mansion starring Eddie Murphy, this actress plays Madame Leota, the head in the crystal ball.
reveal: [whispers] The correct answer is Jennifer Tilly. [excited] Her floating head channels the ride's famous seance room! [chuckles] Talk about a heady role.

clue: In 1997's Flubber, Robin Williams invents bouncing green goo. Its name is short for these two words.
reveal: The correct answer is flying rubber! [laughs] It's a remake of The Absent-Minded Professor from 1961. That goo has a lot of personality.

clue: In the 2021 film Jungle Cruise, Lily Houghton hires skipper Frank Wolff to find a magic tree called this.
reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Tears of the Moon! Its petals can heal anything and lift curses. [chuckles] And yes, Frank's puns came straight from the ride.

clue: At the superhero school in 2005's Sky High, students who are labeled sidekicks go into this track instead of the Hero track.
reveal: The correct answer is Hero Support! [laughs] Coach Boomer decides it in Power Placement, and his word is law. No whiner babies!
